purpose: A LIVE third-party transparency-log proof, frozen as pure data (no executable payload reaches proofbundle's verify path). The rootcommit vectors cover the offline anchor layering; this covers the live counterpart, a bundle issued by a log b7n0de does not operate, verified with witness keys sourced from parties OTHER than that log. SECOND IMPLEMENTATION: tests/test_anchors_markovian_log.py carries a standalone RFC 6962 inclusion recomputation written from the spec (plain hashlib, no proofbundle.merkle) which must reproduce the checkpoint root before proofbundle.tlogproof.verify_tlog_proof is consulted at all, so the two derivations cannot silently drift into each other. NO-OVERCLAIM: (1) leaf 7271 is the log's own stream statement, not an entry we submitted, so the public POST /submit path is NOT exercised here; (2) with the [pq] extra, 8 of the 11 signature lines verify — the two ML-DSA-44 WITNESS cosignatures (navigli, ring-any-bells) are covered since 2026-08-17 by operator-published keys fetched from outside the audited log; WITHOUT the [pq] extra those two count as non-verifying (fail-closed) and 6 of 11 verify, which is now a measured statement about the backend, not a guess; (3) the third ML-DSA-44 line carries the log's own origin name: no independent source can key it today (the operator will publish that key only via an offline-signed trust-root manifest at the next rotation), and the origin-quorum rule refuses to count a signature under the audited log's own origin name toward the witness quorum in any case; (4) rgdd.se/poc-witness and witness1.smartit.nu/witness1 cosigned but their operators' own pages were unreachable on 2026-08-14, so their keys are deliberately not carried and they are not counted toward the quorum; (5) one bundle is a snapshot and says nothing about split-view behaviour over time.
spec: https://c2sp.org/tlog-proof (development version on main as of 2026-08-14; no tagged v1.0.0, unlike tlog-checkpoint / tlog-witness / tlog-cosignature)

upstream.author: Markovian Protocol / Colin <hello@quantsynth.net>
upstream.provenance_note: A live endpoint, not a git commit: /proof/7271 served tree size 7340 on 2026-08-13 and 7341 on 2026-08-14, because the checkpoint moves with the log. Provenance is therefore pinned by retrieval time plus the per-file digests below, not by an upstream revision.
upstream.verification: Verified by b7n0de/proofbundle on 2026-08-14 in two independent passes. Pass one, a standalone RFC 6962 recomputation self-tested against 249 synthetic inclusion paths over tree sizes 1 to 7341 before touching the bundle, reproduced the checkpoint root from the leaf bytes. Pass two, proofbundle 3.7.0 verify-proof --threshold 4, returned ok/log_ok/witnesses_ok/inclusion_ok all true. Flipping one payload bit split the verdict exactly at inclusion_ok. On 2026-08-17 the two ML-DSA-44 witness keys were added after an independent measurement: each keyid recomputed as SHA-256(name || 0x0A || 0x06 || pk)[:4] against the bundle line, each signature verified over the C2SP subtree/v1 cosigned_message against this frozen checkpoint (tree 7341), and a flipped bit in either the signature or the root failed, before either key was carried.

verified_lines.note: 1 Ed25519 log note signature + 5 Ed25519 witness cosignatures always; + 2 ML-DSA-44 witness cosignatures when the [pq] extra provides FIPS 204. Without it the two ML-DSA witnesses count as non-verifying, fail-closed — never a crash, never a silent pass.

origin_name_line_not_carried.reason: the line carries the audited log's own origin name: an INDEPENDENT key for it cannot be sourced without leaning on the audited log (the operator will publish it only via an offline-signed trust-root manifest at the next rotation), and the origin-quorum rule in checkpoint.witness_quorum refuses to count any signature under the checked log's own origin name toward the witness quorum — a log never votes in its own quorum. Decided with the log operator in issue #7 (2026-08-16/17); his /policy declares the quorum as 'group independent-witnesses 4' with the log not a member.

signature_lines.note: Two of the three ML-DSA-44 lines are witness cosignatures (navigli, ring-any-bells) and verify here with the [pq] extra; the third carries the log's own origin name and is excluded from the witness quorum by rule (and has no independently sourceable key today).

files.case: the frozen c2sp.org/tlog-proof bundle as served by the log: header, index, 11-node inclusion path, signed checkpoint, 11 signature lines
files.expect: parses; its checkpoint root is reproduced from leaf_7271.raw by the standalone RFC 6962 recomputation in the test module and by proofbundle.merkle

files.case: the exact raw leaf bytes for index 7271, as served by /leaf/7271
files.expect: SHA-256(0x00 || these bytes) equals the recorded leaf hash; any single-byte change flips inclusion_ok to false while log_ok and witnesses_ok stay true

files.case: the log vkey plus seven witness vkeys (five Ed25519, two ML-DSA-44), each taken from a party other than the audited log; per-line source comments. Extended 2026-08-17 from the six-key set (sha256 c85ca06f09bd3f505ec2e48e41c40432c87114f896e4a8b05f8acfc374678040, 1121 bytes) by the two operator-published ML-DSA-44 witness keys
files.expect: every key ID recomputes as SHA-256(name || 0x0A || algbyte || pubkey)[:4]; not one line comes from the log's own /policy

files.case: recorded --json output of the positive run, verify-proof --threshold 4 with the eight-key file, recorded 2026-08-17 on the origin-quorum work branch (version string 3.8.0, [pq] present). Supersedes the proofbundle 3.7.0 five-witness recording (sha256 1a8a5d73bf0f55a86cbf51eeebb97bbb8eb45bc7ed95a88a14741e3252d2e75e, 907 bytes), which remains in git history as the reference point of the 2026-08-14 audit records

Reproducing the ML-DSA half needs the [pq] extra; without it the two ML-DSA entries report ok=false with a detail naming the missing backend, and the fixture tests assert exactly that instead of skipping silently
